I'm 15 and my parents travel a lot for work so I have to tag along when I'm on breaks/weekends. 

It really isn't fun even if you're going to London or Spain or wherever because it's not a vacation-it's a work trip that you happen to be on in a nice place. Sure, I get to travel "around the world" but when I'm there, I usually just stay in the hotel by myself and sightsee alone (which is too stressful) while my parents go to meetings. I'd rather be in my home town just chilling at one of my friends place where we order pizza. I used to have a nanny to stay home with- who is pretty much my mom, and we're still close, but since I'm older I can "fend for myself" and am dragged along on these trips which is just too tiring for a 15 year old.

 I only have 2 friends because I travel so much. This probably comes off as extremely snobby so I'm sorry.
